binary_mode.description: Enable binary mode for reading input files.

check_mode.description: Enable check mode to verify checksums against provided sums.

text_mode.description: Explicitly set text mode for reading input files.

zero_term.description: End each output line with NUL instead of newline.

ignore_missing.description: Do not fail or report status for missing files during check.

quiet.description: Do not print OK for each successfully verified file.

status_only.description: Do not output anything, only return status code.

strict.description: Exit non-zero for improperly formatted checksum lines.

warn.description: Warn about improperly formatted checksum lines.

files.description: List of input files to process or check.
